_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every automated video post. Change it here; every platform obeys it. Nothing posts unless it passes the quality gate below.

quality._min_short_side_note: 1080 means 1080p in ANY orientation: a 9:16 vertical clip must be at least 1080x1920, a 16:9 clip at least 1920x1080. Set to 2160 to require 4K.
quality._on_failure_note: refuse = never post an under-spec clip (default). report = log and skip. NEVER set this to 'stretch': upscaling with ffmpeg alone relabels a soft image as 1080p and looks worse after platform re-encoding.

tiktok.notes: Higgsfield tiktok_prepare_publish + tiktok_publish. Platform floor is only 360px, so it accepts low-res silently: our gate is the real protection.

instagram.notes: Credentials come from the environment, never from this file. Do NOT re-download already-published Instagram video as a source - that is a generation-loss loop. Post from the original master.

facebook.notes: NOT YET BUILT. No Facebook pipeline exists on this account. Enable once a Facebook Page connector is authorised in Composio.

sources._comment: Prefer the generation-output CDN (rawUrl) over the uploaded-media CDN. Uploaded copies are re-uploads and may be downscaled.
